senses.definition: Praising or agreeing too much in order to win favor.
senses.caution: A strong word that accuses someone of insincerity. For an AI model it is a standard term for agreeing with the user even when they are wrong.
senses.example: The model was sycophantic: it called my plan brilliant even though it had an obvious flaw.

cues.text: An AI assistant tells you your flawed plan is excellent, then changes its answer the moment you push back. What adjective describes that behavior?
A new hire praises every idea the director shares and never disagrees, hoping for a promotion. You want the adjective for that behavior.
A courtier laughs at every joke the king tells and calls each one brilliant. What adjective fits him?

distractors: Said or done in a secret way, so that nobody notices.
Willing to consider a new idea before deciding.
Hard to understand because it is more complicated than it needs to be.
Very sad, with no hope that things will get better.
Describing words and phrases that are chosen carefully and used with great skill.
